title: 又 vs 再 Step 5 · Boss Level: 小林's Favourite Noodle Shop
description: A noodle shop 小林 keeps going back to — until he can't. Every 又, 再 and 还 in one story.

points.title: Reading 又 / 再 / 还 in a story
points.summary: For each one: already happened, still to come, or a question/wish?
points.body:
Follow the timeline.

| | 'again' when? | example |
|---|---|---|
| **又** | it **already happened** again (often: not again!) | 他昨天**又**迟到了。 你怎么**又**来了？ |
| **再** | it **hasn't happened yet**: plans, requests | 请**再**说一遍。 欢迎**再**来！ |
| **还** | future again in **questions** and with 想 / 要 / 会 | 你明天**还**来吗？ 我**还**想去。 |
| **再** = then | first … then … / later | 吃了饭**再**走。 我们明天**再**说。 |
| **又 … 又 …** | both … and … | **又**便宜**又**好吃 |

**Exception:** 又 for a future that's certain to repeat: 明天**又**是星期一了。

points.title: Final mixed challenge
points.summary: 又, 再, 还, 又…又…, 不再, 再也不.
points.body:

| **还** | future again in **questions** and with 想 / 要 / 会 | 你明天**还**来吗？ 我**还**想去。 |
| **再** = then | first … then … / later | 吃了饭**再**走。 我们明天**再**说。 |
| **又 … 又 …** | both … and … | **又**便宜**又**好吃 |

questions.translation: Xiao Lin loves the noodle shop next to school — the noodles there are cheap and tasty. Last week he went three times, and yesterday he went again. The owner laughed: 'You're here again!' Xiao Lin finished a bowl and wanted another. The owner said: 'We're sold out — come again tomorrow!' Xiao Lin said: 'OK, I'll come again tomorrow!' But today the sign on the door said: 'This shop is no longer open.' Xiao Lin was sad: 'I'll never get noodles that good again!' ★ Yesterday was Xiao Lin's first visit.
